(SHRI GULAB SOHANE - ADVOCATE FOR THE RESPONDENT   2  T h is appeal coming on for orders this day  following:
 ORDER

This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the claimants being aggrieved of award dated 15.05.2014 passed by the learned First Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Rewa (M.P.) in claim case No.39/2011 ( Bhaiyalal Rajak and others Vs.
Rajaram Yadav and others) awarding a sum of Rs.4,10,000/- in favour of the claimants.

sentences.text: Though nobody is appearing for the claimants but with the help of Shri Gulab Sohane, learned counsel for the insurance company, award and record is perused.
It has come on record that deceased Prakash who was working as a cleaner on a truck, died in an accident which took place in the intervening night of 4th and 5th January, 2005.
On the date of the accident minimum wages even for an unskilled labourer were to the tune of Rs.2,228/- per month or Rs.26,736/- per annum.
1/3rd is to be deducted towards the living expenses of the deceased then, net dependency will come out to Rs.17,824/-.

40% is to be added towards Future Prospects and then, multiplier of 18 will be applicable, taking total pecuniary compensation to Rs.4,49,165/-, over and above which claimants will be entitled to a sum of Rs.70,000/- under the head of non-pecuniary compensation, taking total compensation to Rs.5,19,165/- against a sum of Rs.4,10,000/- awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal.

Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.1,09,165/- (Rupees One Lakh, Nine Thousand,
One Hundred and Sixty Five) to which claimants will be entitled to in addition to the amount awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal.
This additional amount will also earn interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of filing of claim petition i.e. 16.11.2007 till the date of actual payment.
Other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact.
In above terms, this miscellaneous appeal is disposed of.
Record of the Claims Tribunal be sent back.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE pp Bhaiya Lal Rajak vs Rajaram Yadav on 11 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61354626/
